named_mechanism: Covariance-weighted generalized least squares over shared anchors and calibration layers
assumptions: Common anchor uncertainties induce cross-measurement covariance within each method-anchor subset
Secondary-indicator absolute magnitudes are calibrated from host distances
Low-redshift Hubble law with uncertainty from photometric and peculiar-velocity terms is adequate for the minimal dataset
SBF group calibrators require extra depth scatter handling
non_negotiable_steps: Construct covariance-aware host distance estimates rather than naive unweighted averages
Propagate calibration uncertainty into absolute magnitude estimates
Infer H0 separately by secondary channel and combine with covariance weighting when justified
Report deviations from full published Local Distance Network scope
fidelity_risks: Minimal dataset omits several primary and secondary channels from the full paper
Consensus covariance may need simplifying assumptions absent full covariance products
